Determine the distance $k$ from the eye point to the view plane where the volume raster sampling rate equals the integration grid sampling rate.
The integration grid sampling frequency $\phi(d)$ is greater than the volume raster sampling rate $p$.
Assuming the volume raster is bandlimited such that $p > 2\omega$ (where $\omega$ is the bandlimit frequency), then $\phi(d) > 2\omega$.
